test_new_stream: test creating new CPU or CUDA streams using new_stream for a given torch device
test_current_stream: test getting the current stream for a CPU or CUDA device using current_stream
test_use_stream: test using a context manager to switch to a specific CPU or CUDA stream with use_stream
test_wait_stream: test making one stream wait for another stream to complete using wait_stream
test_record_stream: test recording a tensor to a stream to prevent premature memory reallocation using record_stream
